tenant_requirement_maturity_chk.name: tenant_requirement_maturity_chk
tenant_requirement_maturity_chk.value: ("tenant_requirement"."maturity" IS NULL OR "tenant_requirement"."maturity" BETWEEN 0 AND 5) AND ("tenant_requirement"."target_maturity" IS NULL OR "tenant_requirement"."target_maturity" BETWEEN 0 AND 5)

asset_cia_chk.name: asset_cia_chk
asset_cia_chk.value: "asset"."confidentiality" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "asset"."integrity" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "asset"."availability" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND "asset"."safety" BETWEEN 1 AND 3

risk_rating_chk.name: risk_rating_chk
risk_rating_chk.value: ("risk"."likelihood" IS NULL OR "risk"."likelihood" BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND ("risk"."impact" IS NULL OR "risk"."impact" BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

bia_rto_chk.name: bia_rto_chk
bia_rto_chk.value: "bia"."mtpd_hours" IS NULL OR "bia"."rto_hours" IS NULL OR "bia"."rto_hours" <= "bia"."mtpd_hours"

generated.as:
CASE
        WHEN cardinality(prohibited_practices) > 0 THEN 'prohibited'
        WHEN (annex_iii_area IS NOT NULL AND NOT art6_exception) OR annex_i_product THEN 'high'
        WHEN emotion_or_biometric OR deepfake_or_public_text THEN 'limited'
        ELSE 'minimal' END

cardinality(prohibited_practices) = 0
        AND annex_iii_area IS NOT NULL AND NOT art6_exception
        AND annex_iii_area <> 'critical_infrastructure'
        AND (public_service OR credit_or_insurance)

notification_outbox_idx.name: notification_outbox_idx
notification_outbox_idx.where: email_sent_at IS NULL AND email_queued_at IS NOT NULL
